column2: The first promise of a Savior
Nothing too hard for the LORD
The LORD will fight for you
My presence will go with you
As for me and my house
To obey is better than sacrifice
The LORD looks on the heart
For such a time as this
Blessed be the name of the LORD
Bless the LORD, O my soul
As far as east from west
My help comes from the LORD
Your going out and coming in
A friend loves at all times
A woman who fears the LORD
Unto us a child is born
Fear not, I am with you
Seek the LORD while He may be found
My word will not return empty
Blessed is the one who trusts
Plans for a future and a hope
Seek Me with all your heart
Do justice, love mercy, walk humbly
The just shall live by faith
He rejoices over you with singing
Not by might, but by My Spirit
All things are possible with God
My words will not pass away
To serve and to give His life
Glory to God in the highest
Give, and it will be given
To seek and to save the lost
In the beginning was the Word
Not to condemn but to save
The truth will set you free
Let not your heart be troubled
The way, the truth and the life
The righteous shall live by faith
All things work together for good
Do all to the glory of God
Your labor is not in vain
He who began a good work
In Him all things hold together
Set your mind on things above
Work heartily, as for the Lord
He who calls you is faithful
Power, love and a sound mind
The word is living and active
Stir up love and good works
The same yesterday, today and forever
By His wounds you were healed
Be ready to give an answer
All things for life and godliness
Greater is He who is in you
We love because He first loved us
Able to keep you from stumbling
I stand at the door and knock
